d: Location: Seef / Manama, Kingdom of Bahrain (on-site)
Experience: 10–15 years, including at least 10 in a family office or comparable investment environment.
q: 10+ years of post-qualification finance experience, ideally in a single- or multi-family office, investment holding company, private investment firm or asset manager.
Strong understanding of investments across public and private markets and alternatives.
Proven experience of consolidated financial statements, treasury and liquidity management, budgeting, controls and audit.
Hands-on, self-sufficient style, comfortable building processes from scratch in a lean team.
Absolute discretion and integrity in handling a family’s private affairs.
A trusted adviser who can build a close working relationship with the principal and the family.
Commercially minded, structured and detail-focused, with sound judgement.
Clear communicator who turns complex financial and investment data into simple insight.
r: Our client is a prominent, multi-generational business family operating through their single-family office. Having built a substantial, diversified investment portfolio that was previously administered by an external third-party provider, the client is now bringing its finance and investment operations in-house.
As part of this transition, the client is opening an operational office in Bahrain.

The Chief Financial Officer (CFO) represents the most senior hire in this strategic build-out. Working closely with the Principal, the CFO will take over portfolio management from the external provider, establish the office’s finance function from scratch, and own every aspect of financial management and reporting. The initial team will be lean, with significant scope for growth over time.
Lead the handover of finance, reporting and records from the external provider to the in-house team, with no loss of continuity or control.
Design and implement the office’s finance operating model, including policies, processes, systems and chart of accounts.
Recruit, lead and develop the team and shape the function as the office grows.
Own financial reporting for the family office and its holding entities, including consolidated financial statements.
Deliver clear, timely management reporting to the principal and the family.
Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and regional/local regulatory requirements.
Produce consolidated portfolio reporting across all asset classes, regional and international.
Monitor investment performance, exposures and risk, and present findings and recommendations to the principal.
Support investment decisions with analysis, valuations and due-diligence input.
Manage cash, liquidity and FX across accounts and jurisdictions.
Plan capital calls, distributions and the family’s liquidity needs.
Optimise banking arrangements and cash deployment.
Establish a robust internal control framework with appropriate segregation of duties.
Prepare and manage the office’s annual budget and forecasts.
Lead the external audit and coordinate tax and legal matters with advisers.
Act as main point of contact for banks, codians, fund administrators and external investment managers.
Oversee onboarding, documentation, fees and reporting from all external providers.
The role is hands-on. The CFO will run the full finance and investment operations agenda personally, with the principal’s support.

d: Raffles & Fairmont the Red Sea, positioned in the kingdom's groundbreaking Red Sea Project, will provide visitors access to two nature-focused resorts. With 361 rooms, 11 distinct dining concepts, including overwater restaurant with views of the Red Sea and the mangroves, and a Spa.

Raffles The Red Sea will be a sanctuary of refined elegance and timeless luxury, nestled within Saudi Arabia’s extraordinary Red Sea destination. Blending Raffles’ legendary graciousness and personalized service with the natural beauty and sustainability ethos of Red Sea Global, the property offers a curated haven for the world’s most discerning travelers.
q: Serve as the primary point of contact for in-house guests, ensuring their comfort and satisfaction throughout the stay.
Handle guest feedback, requests, and concerns with empathy, professionalism, and a solutions-driven approach.
Follow up on service recovery actions to ensure issues are fully resolved and guests depart with a positive impression.
Coordinate bespoke amenities, surprises, and experiences in collaboration with Concierge, Butler Service, and F&B teams.
Coordinate arrival, in-house, and departure arrangements for VIPs, long-stay guests, and special-needs guests.
Ensure all VIP amenities, room setups, and personalized touches are delivered accurately and on time.
Act as a liaison between guests and hotel management, escalating feedback or concerns when appropriate.
Work closely with Front Desk, Concierge, Housekeeping, Engineering, and Food & Beverage to ensure seamless service delivery.
Communicate guest preferences and special instructions clearly across departments.
Participate in daily briefings to share guest insights and service priorities.
Uphold Raffles grooming, etiquette, and communication standards at all times.
Demonstrate impeccable manners, cultural sensitivity, and emotional intelligence befitting a luxury heritage brand.
Represent the values, history, and service culture of Raffles Hotels & Resorts in every guest interaction.
Ensure confidentiality and discretion when handling guest information and situations.
Adhere to hotel policies, safety procedures, and brand standards.
Participate in service culture training, brand programs, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Minimum 2–3 years of experience in Guest Relations, Front Office, or Guest Experience roles within a luxury or five-star hotel environment.
Degree or diploma in Hospitality Management or related field preferred.
Experience with property management systems (Opera or equivalent) is an advantage.
High emotional intelligence with the ability to read and respond to guest needs.
Strong problem-solving and service recovery skills.
Excellent organizational ability and attention to detail.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and hotel systems.
Fluency in English and Chinese required; additional languages are a strong advantage.
Naturally warm, gracious, and guest-focused personality.
Polished, elegant appearance and professional demeanor.
Calm, confident, and composed under pressure.
Flexible and able to work shifts, including weekends and holidays.
Understanding of Ultra-Luxury guest expectations and brand alignment.
experience in project coordination, scheduling, and document control during pre-Opening stages.
Experience in pre-Opening is a must.
A proactive, anticipatory approach with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
Impeccable grooming and personal presentation aligned with Luxury standards.
r: Welcome and engage guests in a warm, refined, and genuine manner, ensuring recognition of returning guests, VIPs, and special occasions.
Proactively identify guest preferences, expectations, and emotional cues to personalize interactions and services.
Maintain detailed guest profiles, recording preferences, feedback, and notable interactions to enhance future stays.

d: Neom Group is seeking a commercially driven Marketing Manager to lead the marketing function across its multi-brand restaurant portfolio. The ideal candidate will turn marketing investment into measurable customer growth, stronger sales performance and improved contribution profit.

You will own multi-brand marketing strategy, growth planning and execution. You will partner with Operations, Finance, Cost Control and Supply Chain to drive sustainable growth across dine-in, direct ordering and third-party delivery channels.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration or a related discipline; an MBA or postgraduate qualification is preferred.
Minimum 8 years of progressive marketing experience, including at least 5 years in F&B / restaurant marketing.
Minimum 3 years in a marketing management or leadership role with responsibility for teams, budgets and commercial outcomes.
Proven experience managing marketing across multiple restaurant brands or branches.
Demonstrable achievements in revenue growth, direct-channel development, customer retention and marketing ROI.
Strong knowledge of Kuwait’s restaurant market, delivery aggregators, digital ordering and customer behavior.
Financial literacy covering contribution margin, promotional economics, pricing and sales analysis.
Hands-on familiarity with CRM, loyalty tools, performance marketing, reporting dashboards and analytics.
Professional working proficiency in Arabic and English.

Evidence of growing direct sales, improving restaurant or branch performance, building profitable loyalty programs, managing aggregator exposure and delivering measurable improvements in revenue or contribution profit. Experience in Kuwait is an advantage.
r: Develop annual, quarterly and 90-day marketing plans tied to brand- and branch-level sales performance.
Increase profitable sales across dine-in, direct delivery and digital ordering while optimizing aggregator channel economics.
Build CRM, loyalty, customer segmentation, consent-based WhatsApp engagement and repeat-purchase programs.
Evaluate aggregator promotions, commissions, discounts, advertising investments, conversion and channel contribution.
Work with Finance and Operations on pricing, campaign profitability, menu engineering, average ticket and customer experience.
Design local-store marketing initiatives, corporate partnerships, neighborhood activations and underperforming-branch recovery campaigns.
Lead brand positioning, performance advertising, product launches, digital content and customer acquisition campaigns.
Manage marketing budgets, external partners and the marketing team; report KPIs, insights and improvement actions to leadership.
Coordinate campaigns and product launches in accordance with the company’s established Finance, Operations and Supply Chain approval procedures.

q: Safa Community School is a beacon of excellence. In 2024 we were honoured with the ‘Happiest School in the UAE’ title, a testament to our commitment to student well-being, and we were proud recipients of the ‘Value Add, Leaving No Child Behind Award’. Our GCSE VA score of +2.2, high staff retention and inclusion in the top 15 schools in the UAE (Schoolscompared.com) are a source of pride for us all.

We are more than a school – we are a community. Our parent body is made up of expatriate families, around 35% from the UK, and we are known as a friendly, warm and community-oriented school. Safa is an award-winning, all-through UK curriculum school from FS1 to Year 13 with [number] students. Follow us on Instagram at @safa_scs.

We are seeking a dynamic and passionate Mathematics Teacher to join our highly accomplished secondary department. The successful candidate will be expected to teach across the age and ability range, up to GCSE, with the opportunity to teach A-Level Mathematics (and Further Mathematics where experience allows). A-Level teaching experience is preferred. This role is advertised as part of our strategic growth to meet increasing student enrolment and programme demand.
Plan and prepare courses and lessons; set and mark work; assess, record and report on student development, progress and attainment in line with school policy.
Use data to inform teaching, monitor and track progress, and put timely interventions in place.
Prepare students for public examinations, including assessment, recording and reporting, and attend meetings connected with their conduct.
Communicate and consult with parents, including writing reports; attend Parents’ Evenings and Open Evenings.
Maintain good order and discipline among students.
Participate in departmental meetings and contribute to departmental policy, schemes of work and methods of teaching and assessment.
Support the smooth running of the department through administrative and organisational tasks.
Keep up to date with curriculum innovation and engage in CPD.
Work collaboratively with support teachers, and support a beginning teacher where appropriate.
Set work for classes where absence is known in advance, and cover work for absent colleagues where required.
Take responsibility for a designated area of the curriculum, administration or a project.
Carry out other tasks reasonably directed by the Head of Department.
Familiarise yourself with the DSIB inspection framework and the expectations of outstanding teaching and learning in the UAE.
Be supportive of UAE initiatives and cultural expectations.
Will hold relevant qualifications (a degree in Mathematics or a related subject plus a recognised teaching qualification).
Must have experience teaching in British Curriculum schools, including GCSE/IGCSE Mathematics; A-Level experience is preferred.
Is enthusiastic about Mathematics and able to convey this to students.
Understands assessment and examination requirements for KS3, KS4 and KS5.
Is an outstanding teacher who can demonstrate excellent practice and progress.
Works effectively as part of a team and keeps up to date with subject developments.
Is willing to develop professionally within the department or beyond.
Closing date: Friday, 11 December 2026 at 10h00 UAE time. Applications are assessed in order of receipt, and we reserve the right to appoint before the closing date.
Apply only through the TES/Schrole Portal.
Submit an up-to-date, full CV and a covering letter of no more than two A4 pages.
Provide at least three referees (names, telephone numbers with international dialling codes, and emails); one must be a current employer.
A demonstration lesson will be required. Feedback is provided only to candidates who progress to interview.
